caseMultiple.description: Units per pack (eaches) of the SKU's active CASE level. Case rounding fields (ADR 0017) are present only for a SKU with an active CASE level.

roundedQtyEaches.description: The quantity the transfer moves, cases times caseMultiple.

remainderEaches.description: requestedQtyEaches minus roundedQtyEaches. Positive means that many requested eaches were not moved; negative means the rounding went up.

400.description:
RFC 9457 problem+json error on a keyed route. A 4xx answer produced
by the handler is stored, so a replay carries Idempotency-Replayed:
true; a 400 refused by the key check itself is not stored and carries
no such header.

type.description: Stable machine-readable problem identifier, an absolute URI of the form https://warehouse.example/problems/<kind> (for example .../transfer-not-found).

409.description:
RFC 9457 problem+json conflict. Problem type idempotency-key-reused
means the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request
(method, path or body); any other type is a business conflict.
